page_title: GEN 3-2 BOL | Genoa v Bologna 25/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+8' A yellow card is awarded to Alessandro Marcandalli (Genoa).
90+7' Ruslan Malinovskyi (Genoa) commits a rough challenge and Fabio Maresca blows his whistle for an infringement. A free kick has been awarded to Bologna.
90+6' The referee allows time for a substitution. Brooke Norton-Cuffy will be replaced by Nils Zatterstrom (Genoa).

90+1' 3 - 2 Goal! Junior Messias (Genoa) weaves his way past opponents, and he unleashes a magnificent effort from the edge of the box into the top left corner. Federico Ravaglia had no chance of reaching it. The score is 3:2.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' Junior Messias (Genoa) tries to find Maxwel Cornet, but he puts too much power on the pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bologna.
87' Genoa seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
87' This shall not pass! Ruslan Malinovskyi (Genoa) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
85' 12:15 – this is the current number of fouls committed by both teams.
84' Bologna are awarded a free kick from mid-range. The position is unsuitable for a direct shot, so expect a cross into the box.
81' Brooke Norton-Cuffy (Genoa) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
80' Genoa get a corner.
79' 2 - 2 Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) has acres of space after latching on to a precise pass into the box. He doesn't hesitate to unleash a great effort which ends up in the right side of the goal.
77' Genoa will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
76' Fabio Maresca rightly pulls out a yellow card and shows it to Federico Ravaglia (Bologna).
74' Johan Vasquez will be replaced by Maxwel Cornet (Genoa).
73' Daniele De Rossi has decided to make a change. Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) replaces Vitinha.
73' Substitution. Ciro Immobile makes his way off the pitch and Thijs Dallinga (Bologna) comes on as his replacement.
73' The substitution is prepared. Martin Vitik (Bologna) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Jens Odgaard.
73' The game has come to an end for Jonathan Rowe. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Simon Sohm (Bologna).
72' The ball goes out of play. Bologna are awarded a corner kick.
71' Ruslan Malinovskyi (Genoa) lunges into his opponent and is relieved when the referee only shows him a yellow card.
68' Ciro Immobile (Bologna) picks up a yellow card for an infringement.
67' Vitinha (Genoa) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Bologna will have a goal kick.
66' The Genoa players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.

62' 1 - 2 Ruslan Malinovskyi (Genoa) unleashes a beautiful rocket of a shot from a long-range free kick. The ball goes into the top of the net and leaves the goalkeeper beaten. This takes hours and hours on the training ground. The score is 1:2.
61' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Benjamin Dominguez trots off the pitch and is replaced by Federico Ravaglia (Bologna).
61' It’s taken a long time, but here comes the VAR review into that red card for Lukasz Skorupski (Bologna): it’s upheld, he has to go!

58' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Lukasz Skorupski (Bologna), but referee Fabio Maresca must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
56' Lukasz Skorupski (Bologna) sees a very strict red card that makes him really angry. His indignation can't change the decision of the referee, though.
56' Daniele De Rossi has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Junior Messias (Genoa) replacing Aaron Martin.
56' Substitution. Jeff Ekhator leaves the pitch and is replaced by Ruslan Malinovskyi (Genoa).

55' Bologna slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
54' Genoa have been awarded a corner kick.
53' Jeff Ekhator (Genoa) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Genoa.
53' Genoa will take a corner kick.
51' A pass by Ciro Immobile (Bologna) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Genoa.
47' 0 - 2 Own goal! Sebastian Otoa (Genoa) suffers a good deal of misfortune as he accidentally puts a pass from one of the attacking players into his own net. The score is 0:2.
46' Referee Fabio Maresca blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Ciro Immobile (Bologna) commits a foul and Fabio Maresca immediately signals a free kick. A free kick is awarded to Genoa.
45+1' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.

43' Ciro Immobile (Bologna) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Genoa.
41' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Bologna will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

39' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Bologna are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
38' Lorenzo Colombo (Genoa) is penalised for a foul. Fabio Maresca had a clear view and blows his whistle. Bologna have a free kick.
35' 0 - 1 Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box and fires a low shot towards the bottom left corner that goes in off the post.

34' A sweet pass finds Jonathan Rowe (Bologna) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball low towards the middle of the goal. Justin Bijlow is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second.
32' Charalampos Lykogiannis (Bologna) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
31' Bologna are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
29' Aaron Martin (Genoa) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
28' The referee blows his whistle as Jens Odgaard (Bologna) was too aggressive in his challenge. Genoa win a free kick.
26' Jonathan Rowe (Bologna) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Fabio Maresca blows his whistle for a foul. Genoa will take a free kick.
23' A pass by Jonathan Rowe (Bologna) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.

22' The ball goes out of play and Genoa will have a goal kick. A cross is whipped in towards Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) on the edge of the six-yard box. He wins the ball but sends his header just wide of the right post.
21' Nadir Zortea (Bologna) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
19' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Genoa.

19' Aaron Martin (Genoa) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The linesman points to the corner flag, Genoa are going to take it.
17' Vitinha (Genoa) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
16' Johan Vasquez (Genoa) commits a rough foul. Fabio Maresca stops the game and makes a call. It's a free kick to Bologna, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
14' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Ciro Immobile (Bologna).
9' Wonderful movement by Bologna. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
7' The percentage of ball possession is – 49:51.

6' Sebastian Otoa (Genoa) thinks that he is fouled by his opponent, but the referee deems him to be the one who commits a foul and awards a free kick to the other team. Bologna are awarded the free kick.
3' Genoa seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
1' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Genoa for a penalty. Play continues.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Genoa will kick-off.
Fabio Maresca is the one to supervise the game today.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
